starter-chip.replacementPrompt: Create an original photorealistic CGI render of ONE conventional black 8-pin DIP integrated circuit, the familiar small electronic chip. View it from almost directly ABOVE, with only a little perspective to show its thickness. Orient the body vertically, rotated about 12 degrees clockwise. The compact charcoal-black epoxy body is rectangular, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide, with gently bevelled edges and subtle natural moulded-plastic grain. EXACTLY FOUR evenly spaced separate silver pins extend from the LEFT long edge, and EXACTLY FOUR extend from the RIGHT long edge: EIGHT pins total. Make both four-pin rows fully visible. The silver pins have the ordinary short bent-down shape of a through-hole DIP component. Place ONE shallow U-shaped orientation notch in the TOP short edge only, and a single small pin-one dimple near the upper-left corner. The BOTTOM short edge is STRAIGHT AND UNBROKEN, with no notch, hole, circle or recess. Accurate, modest physical component proportions; believable neutral studio lighting and a subtle light rim on the black edges so it remains readable against light or dark UI. No branding, writing, model number, exposed silicon die, purple, gold, rainbow colours, gem, face, cartoon styling, decorative case, loop, cord, chain, hook, plaque, frame, extra object or cast shadow. The complete chip and all eight pins occupy at most the middle 550 by 550 pixels of the square canvas, with broad empty margins on every side. Fill ALL background areas and all gaps between pins with perfectly uniform chroma green RGB(0,255,0), hex #00FF00. No gradient, ground, backdrop texture, green spill or cropped part. Prioritize a recognizable, technically believable chip silhouette at a small app size.
